name: Ollamux agent usage
author: j-stechmann
description: Publishes an Ollamux usage record for the built-in omarchy.agents panel: token stats from opencode sessions that ran on the ollamux provider, limit meters from the ollamux proxy, and a live concurrency line; plus a bar widget showing proxy request slots in use.

barWidget.description: Live request-slot usage of the ollamux proxy (e.g. 2/6 busy) in the bar, with per-key detail on hover.
